parole.testo: Borrowed from a Northeastern Iranian/Southeastern Iranian language, ultimately from Proto-Iranian *fra-*(h)lágžati, the second element from Proto-Indo-Iranian *slágžʰati.

According to Monchi-Zadeh, the basic meaning is "small hard ball" and is borrowed from a Northeastern Iranian language: compare Pashto ځغاله (źəǧālá, “small lump of dough”). Compare also Armenian կաղաղ (kaġaġ), ցոգոլ (cʻogol).
